title: Looty
desc: Childless couple Rasappa and Geetha adopt the child abandoned in their car. However, problems ensue when Geetha suspects her husband to be the biological father of the child.

title: Sri Raja Rajeswari
desc: Raja and Rajeshwari are killed by Ravindranath and his gang. Before dying, Rajeshwari vows that she will return for revenge and with the blessings of a goddess, she is reborn to keep her promise.

title: Rajasthan
desc: Terrorists target India's nuclear scientists in a brazen attack. The government forms a specialised task force of elite officers to combat the growing threat.

title: Unakkaagave Vaazhgiren
desc: Ravi Shankar, a musician, grief-stricken by a tragedy, meets Chitra, a woman who shares a similar story like him, which makes him realise he is responsible for her misery.

title: Aanandham
desc: As the eldest son, Thirupathisamy shoulders the responsibility of supporting his three younger brothers. However, tensions rise when his brother's wife challenges his authority.
